WITH payment_totals AS (
    -- Sum all payment rows before joining, so each delivered order counts once.
    SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS order_spend
    FROM order_payments
    GROUP BY order_id
), customer_totals AS (
    -- Use all available delivered orders. Keep orders with no recorded payment
    -- in the denominator and flag them; they add nothing to recorded spend.
    SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
           MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS last_purchase_timestamp,
           COUNT(*) AS order_count,
           ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(p.order_spend, 0.0)), 2) AS total_spend,
           SUM(p.order_spend IS NULL) AS orders_without_payment
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN payment_totals AS p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
      AND c.customer_unique_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
), reference_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(last_purchase_timestamp) AS as_of_timestamp
    FROM customer_totals
), customer_rfm AS (
    -- Recency is elapsed days from the customer's latest delivered purchase
    -- to the latest delivered purchase timestamp in the analysis population.
    SELECT c.*, d.as_of_timestamp,
           JULIANDAY(d.as_of_timestamp) - JULIANDAY(c.last_purchase_timestamp) AS recency_days
    FROM customer_totals AS c
    CROSS JOIN reference_date AS d
), percentiles AS (
    -- Rank best to worst. CUME_DIST keeps ties together at the upper end
    -- of their percentile range; not all five scores need to be populated.
    SELECT *,
           CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY recency_days ASC) AS r_pct,
           CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY order_count DESC) AS f_pct,
           CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY total_spend DESC) AS m_pct
    FROM customer_rfm
), scores AS (
    -- 1 = best 20%; then 2, 3, 4, and 5 at successive 20-point cutoffs.
    SELECT *,
           1 + (r_pct > 0.2) + (r_pct > 0.4) + (r_pct > 0.6) + (r_pct > 0.8) AS r_score,
           1 + (f_pct > 0.2) + (f_pct > 0.4) + (f_pct > 0.6) + (f_pct > 0.8) AS f_score,
           1 + (m_pct > 0.2) + (m_pct > 0.4) + (m_pct > 0.6) + (m_pct > 0.8) AS m_score
    FROM percentiles
), cells AS (
    SELECT *, r_score || f_score || m_score AS rfm_cell,
           f_score + m_score AS fm_score
    FROM scores
), segmented AS (
    SELECT *, CASE
        WHEN r_score = 1 AND fm_score BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Champions'
        WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND fm_score BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'Can''t Lose Them'
        WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND fm_score BETWEEN 3 AND 6 THEN 'Hibernating'
        WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND fm_score BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'Lost'
        WHEN r_score IN (2, 3) AND fm_score BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Loyal Customers'
        WHEN r_score = 3 AND fm_score BETWEEN 5 AND 6 THEN 'Needs Attention'
        WHEN r_score = 1 AND fm_score BETWEEN 7 AND 8 THEN 'Recent Users'
        WHEN (r_score = 1 AND fm_score BETWEEN 5 AND 6)
          OR (r_score = 2 AND fm_score BETWEEN 5 AND 8) THEN 'Potential Loyalists'
        WHEN r_score = 1 AND fm_score BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Price Sensitive'
        WHEN r_score = 2 AND fm_score BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Promising'
        WHEN r_score = 3 AND fm_score BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'About to Sleep'
        ELSE 'Unclassified'
    END AS rfm_segment
    FROM cells
), segment_totals AS (
    SELECT rfm_segment,
           COUNT(*) AS segment_customer_count,
           SUM(order_count) AS segment_order_count,
           SUM(total_spend) AS segment_total_spend,
           SUM(orders_without_payment) AS segment_orders_without_payment
    FROM segmented
    GROUP BY rfm_segment
), segment_comparison AS (
    -- Segment and overall averages are order-weighted: spend / order count.
    SELECT *,
           segment_total_spend / NULLIF(segment_order_count, 0) AS segment_avg,
           SUM(segment_total_spend) OVER () / NULLIF(SUM(segment_order_count) OVER (), 0) AS overall_avg,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (
               ORDER BY segment_total_spend / NULLIF(segment_order_count, 0) DESC
           ) AS segment_rank
    FROM segment_totals
)
SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
       c.rfm_segment, c.rfm_cell, c.r_score, c.f_score, c.m_score,
       c.last_purchase_timestamp, c.as_of_timestamp,
       ROUND(c.recency_days, 2) AS recency_days,
       c.order_count, c.total_spend, c.orders_without_payment,
       ROUND(c.total_spend / NULLIF(c.order_count, 0), 2) AS customer_avg_sales_per_order,
       s.segment_customer_count, s.segment_order_count,
       ROUND(s.segment_total_spend, 2) AS segment_total_spend,
       s.segment_orders_without_payment,
       ROUND(s.segment_avg, 2) AS segment_avg_sales_per_order,
       ROUND(s.overall_avg, 2) AS overall_avg_sales_per_order,
       ROUND(s.segment_avg - s.overall_avg, 2) AS segment_avg_difference_vs_overall,
       s.segment_rank AS segment_rank_by_avg_sales_per_order
FROM segmented AS c
JOIN segment_comparison AS s ON s.rfm_segment = c.rfm_segment
ORDER BY s.segment_rank, c.rfm_segment, c.customer_unique_id;

WITH order_payment_totals AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS total_payment
    FROM order_payments
    GROUP BY order_id
), customer_stats AS (
    SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
           COUNT(*) AS number_of_orders,
           SUM(p.total_payment) / COUNT(*) AS average_payment_per_order,
           JULIANDAY(MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) -
           JULIANDAY(MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS lifespan_days
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN order_payment_totals AS p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
    HAVING SUM(p.total_payment) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT customer_unique_id,
       number_of_orders,
       average_payment_per_order,
       CASE WHEN lifespan_days < 7.0 THEN 1.0
            ELSE lifespan_days / 7.0
       END AS customer_lifespan_weeks
FROM customer_stats
ORDER BY average_payment_per_order DESC, customer_unique_id
LIMIT 3;

WITH striker_match_runs AS (
    SELECT b.striker, b.match_id, SUM(s.runs_scored) AS match_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball AS b
    JOIN batsman_scored AS s
      ON s.match_id = b.match_id
     AND s.innings_no = b.innings_no
     AND s.over_id = b.over_id
     AND s.ball_id = b.ball_id
    WHERE b.striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.striker, b.match_id
), qualifying_striker_totals AS (
    SELECT striker, SUM(match_runs) AS total_runs
    FROM striker_match_runs
    GROUP BY striker
    HAVING MAX(match_runs) > 50
)
SELECT AVG(total_runs) AS average_total_runs
FROM qualifying_striker_totals;

WITH appearances AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT player_id, match_id
    FROM player_match
), match_runs AS (
    SELECT b.striker AS player_id,
           b.match_id,
           SUM(s.runs_scored) AS runs
    FROM ball_by_ball AS b
    JOIN batsman_scored AS s
      ON s.match_id = b.match_id
     AND s.innings_no = b.innings_no
     AND s.over_id = b.over_id
     AND s.ball_id = b.ball_id
    GROUP BY b.striker, b.match_id
), player_averages AS (
    SELECT a.player_id,
           AVG(COALESCE(r.runs, 0)) AS avg_runs_per_match
    FROM appearances AS a
    LEFT JOIN match_runs AS r
      ON r.player_id = a.player_id
     AND r.match_id = a.match_id
    GROUP BY a.player_id
)
SELECT p.country_name,
       AVG(pa.avg_runs_per_match) AS country_batting_average
FROM player_averages AS pa
JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id
WHERE p.country_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.country_name
ORDER BY country_batting_average DESC, p.country_name ASC
LIMIT 5;

WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.order_purchase_timestamp,
           c.customer_unique_id, c.customer_city, c.customer_state
    FROM olist_orders AS o
    JOIN olist_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
), top_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS delivered_order_count
    FROM delivered_orders
    GROUP BY customer_unique_id
    ORDER BY delivered_order_count DESC, customer_unique_id
    LIMIT 3

    FROM delivered_orders AS d
    JOIN top_customers AS t ON t.customer_unique_id = d.customer_unique_id
    JOIN olist_order_payments AS p ON p.order_id = d.order_id
    GROUP BY d.customer_unique_id
), ranked_locations AS (
    SELECT d.customer_unique_id, d.customer_city, d.customer_state,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY d.customer_unique_id
               ORDER BY d.order_purchase_timestamp DESC, d.order_id DESC
           ) AS location_rank
    FROM delivered_orders AS d
    JOIN top_customers AS t ON t.customer_unique_id = d.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT t.customer_unique_id, t.delivered_order_count, p.average_payment_value,
       l.customer_city, l.customer_state

WITH RECURSIVE
buckets(bucket) AS (
    VALUES (1)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT bucket + 1 FROM buckets WHERE bucket < 10
),
italian_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN countries AS co ON co.country_id = c.country_id
    WHERE co.country_iso_code = 'IT'
),
december_sales AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT cust_id, prod_id, time_id, channel_id, promo_id, quantity_sold
    FROM sales
    WHERE time_id >= '2021-12-01' AND time_id < '2022-01-01'
),
december_costs AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT prod_id, time_id, channel_id, promo_id, unit_price, unit_cost
    FROM costs
    WHERE time_id >= '2021-12-01' AND time_id < '2022-01-01'
),
customer_profits AS (
    SELECT i.cust_id,
           COALESCE(SUM(s.quantity_sold * (d.unit_price - d.unit_cost)), 0.0) AS total_profit
    FROM italian_customers AS i
    LEFT JOIN december_sales AS s ON s.cust_id = i.cust_id
    LEFT JOIN december_costs AS d
        ON d.prod_id = s.prod_id
       AND d.time_id = s.time_id
       AND d.channel_id = s.channel_id
       AND d.promo_id = s.promo_id
    GROUP BY i.cust_id
),
profit_range AS (
    SELECT MIN(total_profit) AS min_profit, MAX(total_profit) AS max_profit
    FROM customer_profits
),
assigned AS (
    SELECT p.cust_id, p.total_profit,
           CASE
               WHEN r.min_profit = r.max_profit THEN 1
               ELSE MIN(10, 1 + CAST(10.0 * (p.total_profit - r.min_profit)
                                    / (r.max_profit - r.min_profit) AS INTEGER))
           END AS bucket
    FROM customer_profits AS p
    CROSS JOIN profit_range AS r
)
SELECT b.bucket,
       COUNT(a.cust_id) AS customer_count,
       MIN(a.total_profit) AS min_total_profit,
       MAX(a.total_profit) AS max_total_profit
FROM buckets AS b
LEFT JOIN assigned AS a ON a.bucket = b.bucket
GROUP BY b.bucket
ORDER BY b.bucket;

WITH january_daily AS (
    SELECT country_code_2,
           DATE(insert_date) AS insertion_day,
           COUNT(*) AS entry_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN capital = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS capital_entry_count
    FROM cities
    WHERE DATE(insert_date) >= '2022-01-01'
      AND DATE(insert_date) < '2022-02-01'
      AND country_code_2 IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY country_code_2, DATE(insert_date)
), numbered_days AS (
    SELECT *,
           COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY country_code_2) AS january_days,
           JULIANDAY(insertion_day) - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY country_code_2 ORDER BY insertion_day
           ) AS streak_id
    FROM january_daily
), streaks AS (
    SELECT country_code_2,
           MIN(insertion_day) AS period_start,
           MAX(insertion_day) AS period_end,
           COUNT(*) AS consecutive_days,
           1.0 * SUM(capital_entry_count) / SUM(entry_count) AS capital_proportion
    FROM numbered_days
    WHERE january_days = 9
    GROUP BY country_code_2, streak_id
), ranked_streaks AS (
    SELECT *,
           RANK() OVER (
               PARTITION BY country_code_2 ORDER BY consecutive_days DESC
           ) AS streak_rank
    FROM streaks
)
SELECT c.country_name,
       s.period_start,
       s.period_end,
       s.consecutive_days,
       s.capital_proportion
FROM ranked_streaks AS s
JOIN cities_countries AS c ON c.country_code_2 = s.country_code_2
WHERE s.streak_rank = 1
ORDER BY c.country_name, s.period_start;

WITH orders AS (
    SELECT c.rowid AS row_id, c.order_id, c.customer_id, n.pizza_name,
           CASE WHEN n.pizza_name = 'Meatlovers' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS pizza_id,
           c.order_time, c.exclusions, c.extras
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders AS c
    JOIN pizza_names AS n ON n.pizza_id = c.pizza_id
), ingredients AS (
    SELECT o.row_id, CAST(s.value AS INTEGER) AS topping_id
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN pizza_recipes AS r ON r.pizza_id = o.pizza_id
    CROSS JOIN json_each('[' || r.toppings || ']') AS s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM json_each('[' || COALESCE(o.exclusions, '') || ']') AS e
        WHERE CAST(e.value AS INTEGER) = CAST(s.value AS INTEGER)
    )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT o.row_id, CAST(x.value AS INTEGER) AS topping_id
    FROM orders AS o
    CROSS JOIN json_each('[' || COALESCE(o.extras, '') || ']') AS x
), topping_counts AS (
    SELECT i.row_id, t.topping_name, COUNT(*) AS occurrences
    FROM ingredients AS i
    JOIN pizza_toppings AS t ON t.topping_id = i.topping_id
    GROUP BY i.row_id, t.topping_name
)
SELECT o.row_id, o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.pizza_id, o.pizza_name,
       o.pizza_name || ': ' || COALESCE((
           SELECT group_concat(label, ', ')
           FROM (
               SELECT CASE WHEN tc.occurrences > 1
                           THEN '2x' || tc.topping_name ELSE tc.topping_name END AS label
               FROM topping_counts AS tc
               WHERE tc.row_id = o.row_id
               ORDER BY (tc.occurrences > 1) DESC, tc.topping_name COLLATE NOCASE
           )
       ), '') AS ingredient_list
FROM orders AS o
GROUP BY o.row_id, o.order_id, o.pizza_name, o.order_time
ORDER BY o.row_id ASC;

WITH customer_spending AS (
    SELECT o.customerid,
           COALESCE(SUM(od.unitprice * od.quantity), 0) AS total_spent
    FROM orders AS o
    LEFT JOIN order_details AS od ON od.orderid = o.orderid
    WHERE o.orderdate >= '1998-01-01'
      AND o.orderdate <  '1999-01-01'

    GROUP BY o.customerid
)

       COUNT(s.customerid) AS customer_count,
       100.0 * COUNT(s.customerid) /
           NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_spending), 0) AS customer_percentage
FROM customergroupthreshold AS g
LEFT JOIN customer_spending AS s
    ON s.total_spent BETWEEN g.rangebottom AND g.rangetop
GROUP BY g.groupname, g.rangebottom
ORDER BY g.rangebottom;

    FROM payment AS p
    JOIN rental AS r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
    JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
    GROUP BY i.film_id

           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY fa.actor_id
               ORDER BY COALESCE(fr.total_revenue, 0) DESC, f.film_id
           ) AS revenue_rank
    FROM film_actor AS fa
    JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = fa.film_id

WITH RECURSIVE inventory_model (
    product_id, mth, ending_inventory, qty_minimum, qty_purchase
) AS (
    SELECT i.product_id, '2018-12-01', i.qty, p.qty_minimum, p.qty_purchase
    FROM inventory_totals AS i
    JOIN product_minimums AS p ON p.product_id = i.product_id

    UNION ALL

    SELECT r.product_id, b.mth,
           r.ending_inventory - b.qty
           + CASE WHEN r.ending_inventory - b.qty < r.qty_minimum
                  THEN r.qty_purchase ELSE 0 END,
           r.qty_minimum, r.qty_purchase
    FROM inventory_model AS r
    JOIN monthly_budget AS b
      ON b.product_id = r.product_id
     AND b.mth = date(r.mth, '+1 month')
    WHERE b.mth < '2020-01-01'
), differences AS (
    SELECT product_id, mth, ABS(ending_inventory - qty_minimum) AS abs_diff
    FROM inventory_model
    WHERE mth >= '2019-01-01'
), ranked AS (
    SELECT product_id, mth, abs_diff,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY abs_diff, mth
           ) AS rn
    FROM differences
)
SELECT product_id, mth, abs_diff
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY product_id;

    FROM driver_totals
    GROUP BY year
),
constructor_maxima AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(total_points) AS max_points
    FROM constructor_totals
    GROUP BY year
)
SELECT d.year
FROM driver_maxima AS d
JOIN constructor_maxima AS c ON c.year = d.year
ORDER BY (d.max_points + c.max_points) ASC, d.year ASC
LIMIT 3;

WITH season_finales AS (
    SELECT r.year, r.race_id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY r.round DESC, r.race_id DESC) AS rn
    FROM races AS r
    WHERE r.year >= 2001
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_standings AS ds WHERE ds.race_id = r.race_id)
), ranked_drivers AS (
    SELECT f.year, ds.driver_id,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY f.year ORDER BY ds.points) AS points_rank
    FROM season_finales AS f
    JOIN driver_standings AS ds ON ds.race_id = f.race_id
    WHERE f.rn = 1 AND ds.points > 0
), scoring_constructors AS (
    SELECT r.year, res.driver_id, res.constructor_id
    FROM results AS res
    JOIN races AS r ON r.race_id = res.race_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001 AND res.points > 0
    UNION
    SELECT r.year, sr.driver_id, sr.constructor_id
    FROM sprint_results AS sr
    JOIN races AS r ON r.race_id = sr.race_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001 AND sr.points > 0
)
SELECT c.name AS constructor, COUNT(DISTINCT rd.year) AS season_count
FROM ranked_drivers AS rd
JOIN scoring_constructors AS sc ON sc.year = rd.year AND sc.driver_id = rd.driver_id
JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructor_id = sc.constructor_id
WHERE rd.points_rank = 1
GROUP BY c.constructor_id, c.name
ORDER BY season_count DESC, c.name, c.constructor_id
LIMIT 5;
